description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on DeepSeek V4 Pro, a top open frontier model with reasoning, tool calling and a 1M-token context. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/deepseek-pro and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $2.64 per million input and $7.92 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.2178. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (tool calling, reasoning, streaming supported), up to 8192 output tokens. Costs $0.2178 USDC per call (x402).
